# Find and install skills
<!-- generated by docs:update_by_ai -->
<!-- page type: how-to -->

Find a skill from skills.sh, a local folder, or a public GitHub or GitLab folder, inspect it, and install it.

## Open Find new skills

<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/window/find_new_skills_window.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/MoreMenu.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FindNewSkillsModal.vue -->

Open the **More** menu and choose **Find new skills**. Choose **User** to make the skill available across workspaces, or **Workspace** to make it available in the selected workspace.

## Choose a source and find a skill

<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/window/find_new_skills_window.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/skills/SkillsSourceSwitch.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/skills/FindSkills.vue -->

1. Choose **skills.sh**, **Local folder**, or **Code hosting** under **Source of the skill**.
2. For **skills.sh**, type search words. For **Local folder**, enter the full folder path or select **Choose folder…**. For **Code hosting**, enter the web address of a folder on GitHub or GitLab.
3. Wait for the results. A skill is a folder containing a `SKILL.md` file; the result rows show the skill name and where it comes from.
4. Select **Inspect** to read the skill before installation.

## Install a result

<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/window/find_new_skills_window.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/skills/SkillSearchResultRow.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/stores/skills.ts -->

Select **Install** on the result row. If a skill with the same name is already installed at the selected level and its `SKILL.md` differs, confirm **Replace**; the installed skill moves to the Trash before the new skill is installed.

## Related pages

- [Change Heidrun Code settings](/documentation/settings): enable a coding agent before installing skills if none is enabled.
